brief.industry: A private mobile notebook for freelance writers: collect scattered phrases and bring them together into one short daily draft.
brief.audience: Independent writers who want a calm, tangible sense of progress without streak pressure.
palette: Warm paper #F6EEE4 for the full square background
use_cases: Mobile app icon, recognize at 32 and 48 pixels among other apps

app_icon.subject: one folded paper slip with a shallow central ridge

concept: SEAM makes collected phrases feel tangible. One tactile folded paper slip with a clear silhouette, near-frontal view, consistent matte material and restrained depth.
